name: Structural Brackets, Panels & Reinforcements
summary: Stamped and formed sheet-metal components produced on 20 – 250 tonne presses with in-house progressive and deep-draw tooling.
description: Stamped, formed and deep-drawn brackets, panels and reinforcement components covering a wide size and gauge range. Parts run on our 20 to 250 tonne press line using progressive and deep-draw tooling designed and built in our own tool room — which means the die that forms your part is maintained by the people accountable for the part, and a revision takes days rather than weeks. Suitable for everything from small precision clips to heavier structural reinforcements.
